facts.fact: The Secretary to the Government of the Federation said at the National Day of Identity that the enactment of the National Identity Management Commission Act, 2026 gave the identity system a stronger legal foundation and made NIMC the root certification authority for identity; no enactment date is given, so the event date is used.

note: Standing only; the document does not state that the Act sets up a biometric register or unique number, or any dated rule made under it.
